userSentence: I will deal carefully with every problem that appears in my work this week.
aiRevision: I will deal with every problem at work this week.
errorTags: 'deal carefully with' 不符合 A1 水平常用搭配；A1 学习者应掌握 'deal with' 作为固定短语，不加副词修饰；'that appears' 属于定语从句，超出 A1 语法范围；'in my work' 表达不够自然，日常中更常说 'at work'
suggestion: A1 学习者应优先掌握基础短语 'deal with' 的基本用法（如：I deal with problems / We deal with customers）。避免添加副词或复杂从句。可替换为简单、高频表达，如 'I will deal with every problem at work this week.' 这样更准确、自然且符合水平。
